correctness.rationale: The source code independently generates all 937 nonempty faces from the Petersen graph definition, constructs and verifies a 465-pair acyclic matching across 4440 covers with critical profile one 0-cell and six 6-cells, and computes the signed Lefschetz traces of all 120 S5 actions. The resulting seven class values agree with the exact standard exterior-square formula, and weighted squared norms sum to 120, proving irreducibility. The argument explicitly depends on no unproved extension beyond this finite graph.

value.rationale: Determining a complete irreducible homology representation for the natural S5 action on a canonical highly symmetric Kneser graph is a structural equivariant invariant that is not specified by the previously known six-sphere wedge type. The result identifies the precise Specht module and every class trace, motivated by the graph and the unexplained symmetry of its homology rather than an arbitrary slice of a parameter census.
